title: Bidirectional Interpolation for the Lambda-Calculus: Revisiting and Formalising Craig-Čubrić Interpolation
summary: Craig's Interpolation theorem has a wide range of applications, from mathematical logic to computer science. Proof-theoretic techniques for establishing interpolation usually follow a method first introduced by Maehara for the Sequent Calculus and then adapted by Prawitz to Natural Deduction. The result can be strengthened to a proof-relevant version, taking proof terms into account: this was first established by Čubrić in the simply-typed lambda-calculus with sums and more recently in linear, classical and intuitionistic sequent calculi.
